text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 400, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "$400"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3/4"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3/4"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "green-hat sales in month 1 (red sales were half of green sales)"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "total sales in month 1 (red + green)"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "numerator for month 2 sales = 3 * month1 total"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "month 2 sales = 3/4 of month 1 total"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "total sales across both months"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "total amount Ariadne made across the two months"}, "dismissed": []}
